name: admiral-mcp
description: Agent-harness-to-iPhone pager bridge. Lets AI agent harnesses page your iPhone for approval and stream job progress via Live Activities.

tools.name: register_run
tools.description: Announce a new agent job to the pager

tools.name: update_progress
tools.description: Advance a run phase and push a Live Activity update

tools.name: request_approval
tools.description: Request human approval and block until decision or timeout

tools.name: resolve_approval
tools.description: Resolve a pending approval from the phone callback

tools.name: get_diff
tools.description: Serve diff content to the iOS app by reference
